title: Air Key West

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Cargo - Overnight not fast enough? Call Air Key West for immediate airport to airport delivery of urgent packages. Private charters are ON-DEMAND- the itinerary is set by you. We fly at the day and time of your convenience, to and from anywhere you wish. When you charter, you charter the aircraft, not just a seat on the aircraft. However, for smaller parties and if you so desire, we can place your name on a “SHARE” list, whereby you can split the fare with another party. If interested in charter sharing, please let us know and we will add your name to the SHARE list and attempt to pair you with another party wanting to travel the same approximate day and time.
